pdf_explanation: The pattern on the left is rotated by 180° to get the pattern on right.
why: Figure 1 is turned upside down (rotated 180°) to give figure 2: the thick bar that pointed up on the right now points down on the left. Do the same to figure 3: the spike with the dot goes to the bottom and the spike with the square goes to the left, which is option 2. Option 1 is tempting, but it is only a top-to-bottom mirror image, so the square spike stays on the right.
trick: For a 180° rotation, every part moves to the opposite side (top to bottom AND left to right). If only one side changes, it is a mirror image, not a rotation.
note: PDF answer B matches the figures: B is the exact 180° rotation of figure 3.
